definition: For either field, grant a predictor the identity of every single capture and its class-conditional frequencies. The best possible balanced accuracy equals one half the sum, over identities, of the larger of the two class-conditional frequencies. Identical single-capture distributions across classes imply chance performance independently of a chosen classifier. All 16 relative pose combinations occur for each paired base form. Both scanners together are visible during deployment.
